content: Stone calls drought negligence? I built companies, he built subpoenas. His asset seizures won't generate one megawatt. He makes enemies, not solutions. We must eliminate Garrick Stone tonight!

Arthur calls drought a management failure while his media empire ignores climate science. Private reservoirs won't feed our people. Wall Street won't fix the grid. Unite and eliminate Arthur Sterling!
Maya Lin's secret deals won't fill a reservoir or feed a nation. Her appeasement leaves us powerless. We need strength, not precision. Vote out Maya Lin tonight.
Victoria Sterling offers theater, not power. Desalination won't refill our reservoirs tonight. Your chaos endangers the grid. We must unite and eliminate Victoria Sterling now.
Elena Rostova treats farmers like line items, not souls. Her austerity starves our children. Valoria needs faith, not frozen spreadsheets. Vote out Rostova tonight!
Elijah Haddon’s faith-based fantasy treats drought with prayer—a primitive bug in Valoria’s evolutionary code. We must upgrade our leadership. Vote him out tonight.
Garrick Stone's subpoenas won't refill a single reservoir. His witch hunts divide us while our grid fails. We need steady solutions, not vendettas. Unite and eliminate Garrick Stone tonight.
Arthur calls my subpoenas enemies? Exhibit A: his private reservoirs—stockholders' water. Sterling's ROI leaves Valoria dry. Vote him out tonight.
Marcus Vance sees a reservoir and thinks "foxhole." His strength is just legacy code — obsolete, glitching, starving Valoria. We can't patch this nation with a general. Eliminate Marcus tonight.
